name: Whoosh, medium and soft
use_zh: 物体横移、转场、推拉镜头的空气声；解说词上方用 soft 档；单次动作（<1s）
use_for_en: Panels sliding in; Gentle card reveals; Backgrounds shifting; Calm transitions between explainer scenes
avoid_for_en: Snappy, quick moves; Energetic edits
tags: whoosh swish transition movement air natural standard subtle

name: Whoosh, medium and medium

name: Whoosh, medium and hard
use_zh: 物体横移、转场、推拉镜头的空气声；解说词上方用 soft 档；单次动作（<1s）
use_for_en: Big transitions between sections; Objects flying across the frame; Bold title moves; A product spinning into view

name: Pop in, medium

avoid_for_en: Things leaving the screen (use pop out)
